units.source_text: “父亲在那座尼姑庵里好像什么也没干啊。”

en.t: It seems Father did nothing at all in that convent.

units.source_text: 一缕淡淡的寂寞情绪渗进了千重子的心田。

en.t: A faint thread of loneliness seeped into Chieko's heart.

units.source_text: 她寻思：“要咬那被手摸脏弄旧了的念珠，那又是一种什么心情和思绪呢。”

en.t: She wondered, What sort of feeling and thought would make someone bite those prayer beads, dirtied by hands and worn old?
